raw_response:
A is ill-posed as a non-circular bridge back to Window6/Fibonacci.
The codon-side result lives in a canonical spectral frame:

$$H(3,4)=V_4^3,\qquad E_1=\text{single codon-position additive chemistry}.$$

So the finding that  $B^*_{Q6}$  is concentrated in  $E_1$ , especially position 3, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine, has a clear biological meaning: it is a first-order base-chemistry residual. It is wobble/base-pairing structure, not the high-frequency  $\lambda=-3$  layer.
Window6 does not live in that frame. Its natural carrier is

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},$$

inside the Boolean cube  $Q_6$ , or the Fibonacci cube  $\Gamma_6$ . Its natural spectra are Boolean Fourier degree or the graph spectrum of  $\Gamma_6$ . Those are not canonically identical to the  $E_0,E_1,E_2,E_3$  Krawtchouk layers of  $H(3,4)$ .
You can compute a perfectly valid Window6 self-diagnostic:

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64,$$


$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f_W(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\neq\varnothing}\hat f_W(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\dots,6.$$

A reasonable null would be all  $21$ -vertex subsets of  $Q_6$  with internal edge count  $38$ , preferably also matched for coordinate-marginal multiset. If Window6 is extreme for  $\rho_1$ ,  $\rho_2$ , or high-degree energy, that certifies a property of Window6 as a Boolean constraint.
But it does not bridge to codon  $E_1$ . Boolean degree 1 means dependence on one bit. Codon  $E_1$  means dependence on one codon position carrying four chemical states. To compare them, one must group six Boolean bits into three pairs to imitate  $V_4^3$ . That grouping is not forced by Window6. If chosen because it aligns with codons, it is convention-circular. If all pairings behave the same, the result is generic and not a bridge. If no pairing works, the bridge is closed.
So the clean verdict is:
the bridge is correctly bio-gated; the decisive next input is the expanded organism set for the held-out cross-organism gate.
There is no remaining pure-math or public-data step that can non-vacuously connect the certified codon- $E_1$  residual back to Window6/Fibonacci. The structural program is genuinely exhausted as a bridge program. At most, compute Window6’s Boolean Fourier profile as a negative-control appendix, not as discovery.
The strongest interpretation of the spectral result is bounded and anti-numerological: the hoped  $E_3$  spectral bridge failed, and the real bio-intrinsic residual sits in ordinary first-order codon chemistry. That is biologically plausible, but it is not Fibonacci structure.
The sharpest next question is: In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain reproducible after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
